trophies.guide: No separate task — this pops the moment the other 54 are earned. Follow the roadmap and tick everything off; the platinum arrives with the last trophy.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It is the first thing you play, so this unlocks as soon as the story starts.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to its last mission. Nothing here can be missed — just follow the story beats.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Clear every mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's mission line. Do the side content you pass along the way, but the chapter itself is unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to the end — the last full chapter before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Make sure the one missable trophy is already done before you start the finale.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the Breakfast Run story mission when it comes up in the mission flow.
trophies.name: Trust
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. It appears in the story — no special prep needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play mission. Story-only and unmissable.
trophies.name: Family Matters
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission as part of the main story path.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission, which opens during the airport arc of the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Story-only.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the stats screen — story, side strands, activities, collectibles, exploration and money all count. Leave this for last and use the checklist as the plan.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Chase 250 stunts across the whole game — big jumps, near misses, long airtime and high-speed runs all count toward the same total. The best approach is to attempt a stunt whenever the road invites one instead of farming them in one place; every attempt adds up over the full playthrough, so this finishes itself if you keep driving boldly.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once — fishing, races, shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each drill has its own rhythm, so study the target pattern before you start shooting, choose the weapon the drill asks for, and treat misses as practice runs — the gold line is about clean, steady accuracy, and replaying a silver is how you learn the timing.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Learn each course's gates, cut corners where the track allows, and save boost for the long straights.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types. Any win counts per race, so start with the shortest events and match your vehicle to the class.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Watch the line tension, reel when the fish runs toward you, and keep the rod steady — patience wins this one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any cabinet. Pick a short one and play it through to the end screen.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Contact missions unlock as the story progresses, so check back with Andy between chapters.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. His missions open up over the story — clear them whenever they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Work through his mission line as it unlocks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers show as markers on the map — take each strand to its end, and sweep the map again after each chapter since new strands unlock as the story advances.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Clear his jobs as they appear in the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. His line unlocks alongside the story — do not leave it until after the finale.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy you can lock yourself out of. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and do them as you first reach each region: a few spots sit in places the story changes later, so a post-game sweep may come too late. Tick each spot off here the moment you meditate there.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt opens, track the animal patiently, and take the shot when it holds still.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards hide across Leonida — check shops, hidden corners and mission rewards, and trade duplicates where you can.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are spread across the map — work through them region by region and use the checklist to track which areas are done.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and more — they accumulate naturally, so check the challenges menu often and mop up the easy ones late.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build the heat up together, then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the stars clear — alleys and the water help.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route with three close shops, keep a fast car ready, and move fast between them — do not stop to fight.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive everything you see — each new model counts once, so vary your rides and visit different neighborhoods and vehicle spots.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus. Find a group, trigger focus when they cluster, and chain headshots — tight spaces with several enemies are the best setup.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Grab a plane on the airfield and get airborne without following the usual route — speed matters more than stealth here.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. Use explosives and heavy weapons from cover, keep moving, and do not trade shots in the open.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, watch the cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a silent approach beats a loud one.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Sort the escape before the robbery: park a fast car nearby, pick a route that avoids police patrols, and leave the moment the vault is open. Five vaults, five clean getaways — rushing the exit is what gets you caught.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take the cash, and lose the heat — a second vehicle stashed nearby makes the escape much easier.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive every road and visit every corner — the map fills in as you go, and the last few areas are usually the remote ones.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation of each of the 9 gangs. Hit a different gang's operation each time and expect heavy resistance — go in prepared.
trophies.name: Pest Control
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find the beachside spot, order a drink, and take in the view — a quiet story moment.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Pick a showroom, pick a fast car, and go straight through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley. A full game counts — aim for the pocket and follow through.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal. This one comes from playing through the partner story — it unlocks as your partnership grows.
trophies.name: Personal Best
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Make choices along the way. The game tracks the decisions you make — keep playing and choosing, and this pops as the count builds.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. If something fails once, try it again — the second attempt is the one that counts.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. Keep your eyes open while exploring Leonida's odd corners — strange things happen when you least expect them.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. Line up a slow pass with a melee weapon ready and swing as you roll past.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Run marked bills through your contacts steadily — it adds up across many jobs, so start early.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count — big purchases late in the game finish this off fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Save up and purchase them as they become available — they also give you storage for the vehicle collection.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the app, and register each one — variety counts, duplicates do not.
trophies.name: On the Spot
sources: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy guide
